pages.title: Revealing Moon
pages.text: An eye opens in the sky. It blinks.

Every 60 seconds you see "The eye is searching..." and a 5-second countdown. When it ends, the eye opens fully and everyone within 256 blocks of you is marked for 8 seconds with a spectral eye, an approximate distance and a direction (never coordinates).

Underground players are marked at the surface above them: only their horizontal position shows.$(br2)$(l)Never revealed:$() spectators, creative players, War Moon fighters and areas the server protects. Claims are not hidden automatically.$(br2)$(l)Counterplay:$() keep moving between scans.
